public_api.note: Release 0.4.0a2 extends the LOT-18 subledger foundations with LOT-19 operational subledger mechanics: immutable partial/full many-to-many settlement allocation with revision guards, explicit settlement reversal, candidate-versus-validated accounting matching, deterministic PaymentTerm due schedules, explicit aging policies/snapshots, normalized subledger-to-control-account reconciliation and a fail-closed write-off authorization boundary. Allocation never becomes a second General Ledger posting path; aging does not perform impairment; no national account-prefix heuristics or LOT-20 financial-analysis metrics are introduced. The public Python API remains intentionally unfrozen before 1.0.
